# Tool Paper (ICSE SEET 2027)

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| **Page limit** | Max **5 pages**, plus **1 page of references** (strict; violations are desk-rejected) |
| **Definition** | Describes a tool or technology that supports SE education and training. Must discuss the **impact of the tool on the learning process**. |
| **Optional video** | A short video (**≤ 5 minutes**) demonstrating the tool's main functionality. If used, the link must be provided **at the end of the abstract**. |
| **Evaluation criteria** | Relevance, Significance, Maturity, Availability, Presentation (see [criterion definitions](../../evaluation-criteria)) |
